title: fix(cohere): send stop, top_p and max_completion_tokens under Cohere's names

files.patch:
@@ -79,6 +79,13 @@ def _convert_completion_params(params: CompletionParams, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[
             exclude_none=True,
             exclude={"model_id", "messages", "response_format", "stream", "stream_options", "reasoning_effort"},
         )
+        # Cohere's chat endpoint names these differently from the OpenAI parameters CompletionParams uses.
+        if (stop := converted_params.pop("stop", None)) is not None:
+            converted_params["stop_sequences"] = [stop] if isinstance(stop, str) else stop
+        if (top_p := converted_params.pop("top_p", None)) is not None:
+            converted_params["p"] = top_p
+        if (max_completion_tokens := converted_params.pop("max_completion_tokens", None)) is not None:
+            converted_params["max_tokens"] = max_completion_tokens
         if params.reasoning_effort != "auto":
             if params.reasoning_effort is None or params.reasoning_effort == "none":
                 converted_params["thinking"] = {"type": "disabled"}

     result = _create_openai_chunk_from_cohere_chunk(ToolPlanDeltaV2ChatStreamResponse(), "command-a-03-2025")

+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("openai_params", "cohere_params"),
+    [
+        ({"stop": "END"}, {"stop_sequences": ["END"]}),
+        ({"stop": ["a", "b"]}, {"stop_sequences": ["a", "b"]}),
+        ({"top_p": 0.5}, {"p": 0.5}),
+        ({"max_completion_tokens": 64}, {"max_tokens": 64}),
+        ({"max_tokens": 32, "max_completion_tokens": 64}, {"max_tokens": 64}),
+        ({"max_tokens": 32}, {"max_tokens": 32}),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_openai_style_params_are_renamed_for_chat(
+    openai_params: dict[str, Any], cohere_params: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    provider = _mk_provider()
+
+    with (
+        patch.object(provider.client, "chat", autospec=True) as mock_chat,
+        patch("any_llm.providers.cohere.cohere._convert_response", return_value=Mock()),
+    ):
+        await provider.acompletion(model="model-id", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], **openai_params)
+
+    sent = mock_chat.call_args.kwargs
+    for name in ("stop", "top_p", "max_completion_tokens"):
+        assert name not in sent
+    for name, value in cohere_params.items():
+        assert sent[name] == value
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_openai_style_params_are_renamed_for_chat_stream() -> None:
+    provider = _mk_provider()
+
+    async def _stream() -> Any:
+        if False:
+            yield None
+
+    with patch.object(provider.client, "chat_stream", autospec=True, return_value=_stream()) as mock_chat_stream:
+        result = await provider.acompletion(
+            model="model-id",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+            stop="END",
+            top_p=0.5,
+            max_completion_tokens=64,
+            stream=True,
+        )
+        assert [chunk async for chunk in result] == []
+
+    sent = mock_chat_stream.call_args.kwargs
+    for name in ("stop", "top_p", "max_completion_tokens"):
+        assert name not in sent
+    assert sent["stop_sequences"] == ["END"]
+    assert sent["p"] == 0.5
+    assert sent["max_tokens"] == 64
